description: Before taking office, Governor Kotek set an ambitious goal: Visit all 36 counties in her first year in office. On her One Oregon Listening Tour, the Governor met with more than 1,000 Oregonians to better understand the needs of communities across the state. Oregon Capital Insider: “In Eastern Oregon, Tina Kotek showed up and listened” […]

title: Ensuring Every Oregon Community is Heard - Tina for Oregon
